searchText: does anyone know why participation rate is so low since yestarday? Validators 312 through 439 have been offline for 2 days. Probably all belong to one staker. The drop in participation seems to correlate with when they all stopped attesting. They account for 18% of validators. Mh, yeah just checked. It's my teku validator Oh nose! You might want to update to latest master - it has some useful attestation and proposal fixes. Ok, I will do that. Do you want me to share the log anyways? There's also a PR which fixes a file-handle leak. That killed Adrian's node yesterday. https://github.com/PegaSysEng/teku/pull/2013 I've been using this today, and it seems good. Not merged yet, though. Yeah, if you can get the logs to <@!340345049063882753> it's probably worth it. Not much I can do with them 😂 Ok happy sunday <@!340345049063882753> ^^ https://termbin.com/4z8y (It's already Monday for Adrian 🤔) <@!557201004060213248> Thanks. Those were the block production errors fixed late last week with https://github.com/PegaSysEng/teku/pull/1998 Will trawl through for any other interesting problems to fix today as well.
